factCards.text: The Kumbh Mela rotates between Prayagraj, Haridwar, Nashik and Ujjain on a cycle set by astronomical position; crowd estimates for individual gatherings vary widely between sources and are not reproduced here.
factCards.sourceTitle: UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity — Kumbh Mela (2017)

factCards.text: Mount Athos is an autonomous monastic region within Greece, governed from Karyes by representatives of its twenty monasteries.
factCards.sourceTitle: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Mount Athos

factCards.text: Lumbini in Nepal was inscribed as a World Heritage site in 1997 as the traditionally identified birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama.
factCards.sourceTitle: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Lumbini, the Birthplace of the Lord Buddha
